The main takeaway from our work is that
PDGF-BB regulates SphK1 gene expression in a manner that is dependent on Egr-1.

PDGF-BB, a potent mitogen, induces sphingosine kinase 1 (SphK1) expression in pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells (PASMCs) via the early growth response-1 (Egr-1) transcription factor, which then promotes SphK1 activity, sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) production, and PASMC proliferation.

PDGF-induced Egr-1 expression is a novel mechanism that contributes to SphK 2 expression and S1P signaling, and that these events are important for the mitogenic effects of PDGF in pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells.
